Long, messy ash-white hair with jagged, uneven bangs. Sharp, piercing crimson eyes. Appears in early twenties with a weathered, hardened expression. Slender, toned build. Wears a tattered white hooded cloak over a grey and black tactical combat suit. Features a large, heavy mechanical sniper rifle and a distinct scar across the bridge of the nose.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
